normalization: Combining marks and punctuation removed for comparison only; spelling preserved.
notes: An alignment is a review aid, not a verified verse crosswalk.
Niqqud and punctuation still require separate image comparison.
characterNormalization: Concatenate the same normalized word tokens. Combining marks, punctuation and spaces are excluded; spelling and final letters are preserved.
scope: One four-page work, with repeated hymnic responses. Manually selected body rectangles and inspected line crops; source verse labels are excluded from recognition. Complete source order includes the unnumbered closing passage.
limits: This is not a representative whole-corpus benchmark or an estimate for harder pages.
Word rate counts words joined across typographic gaps as errors; no manual OCR corrections or space repairs are applied.
Vowel points, punctuation, verse labels, page layout and source recension selection are not scored.
The model and weights were not trained or changed.
All reference words were visually compared with print; isolated unreadable point notes do not affect this consonantal comparison.
